description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dobagammana, Nivithigla D/S/Division Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620393 (24/0321)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their location, extent, ownership details, and legal status. The content focuses entirely on land administration, property rights, and title settlement processes, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
